rules.name: 静息心率过高
rules.condition: heart_rate is not None and heart_rate > 120 and not screen_active and hr_sustained_high_count >= 3 and last_message_seconds > 120
rules.message_template: 你的心率有点不对劲——{heart_rate}，而且持续好几分钟了，屏幕也没怎么动。你还好吗？

rules.name: 心率骤升
rules.condition: heart_rate is not None and hr_avg_prev_5min is not None and hr_avg_prev_5min > 0 and heart_rate - hr_avg_prev_5min > 40 and not screen_active and last_message_seconds > 120 and user_status != 'out'
rules.message_template: 你的心率突然从 {prev_avg} 跳到 {heart_rate} 了，而且你好像没在做什么剧烈的事。没事吧？
rules.display_cond: ΔHR>40 静息 外出豁免

rules.name: 心率轻度偏高
rules.condition: heart_rate is not None and heart_rate > 105

rules.name: 心率基线偏高
rules.condition: heart_rate is not None and hr_baseline_mean > 0 and heart_rate > hr_baseline_mean + (3 if is_period else 2) * hr_baseline_stddev and not is_cold_start

rules.name: 步数严重偏低
rules.condition: steps_today is not None and steps_baseline_mean > 0 and steps_today < steps_baseline_mean * 0.3 and not is_cold_start

rules.name: 上班时间还在家
rules.condition: location_category == 'home' and __work_hours__ and user_status != 'out' and not wfh_today
rules.message_template: 这个点还在家？今天不用去公司吗？还是今天居家办公呀？
rules.display_cond: 工作时段在家 GPS新鲜 非居家办公
